author: Sirunyan, A.M. and others
title: Measurement of properties of $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decays and search for $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ with the CMS experiment
abstract: Results are reported for the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ branching fraction and effective lifetime and from a search for the decay $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$. The analysis uses data samples of proton-proton collisions accumulated by the CMS experiment in 2011, 2012, and 2016. The branching fraction of the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay is measured to be $[2.9^{+0.7}_{-0.6} (\\text{exp}) \\pm 0.2 (\\text{frag})] \\times 10^{-9}$. The effective lifetime is measured to be $1.70^{+0.61}_{-0.44} \\pm 0.05$ ps. An upper limit of $3.6 \\times 10^{-10}$ is set on the $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ branching fraction at 95% confidence level.
